text_en: In the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed such dreams that his spirit was troubled and his sleep left him.
text_cn: 拿步高在位第十二年，拿步高一连做了几个梦，遂心神不宁，不能入睡。

text_en: So the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be summoned to tell the king his dreams. When they came in and stood before the king,
text_cn: 于是君王下令召巫师、术士、方士和占星者前来给君王详梦；他们前来了，站在君王前，

text_en: he said to them, “I have had such a dream that my spirit is troubled by the desire to understand it. ”
text_cn: 君王对他们说：“我做了一个梦，心神不宁，急于要知道这梦的究竟。”

text_en: The Chaldeans said to the king (in Aramaic), “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will reveal the interpretation. ”
text_cn: 占星者【用阿剌美语】回答君王说：“大王万岁！请大王给你的仆人们说出梦来，我们好给大王解释那梦的意义。”

text_en: The king answered the Chaldeans, “This is a public decree: if you do not tell me both the dream and its interpretation, you shall be torn limb from limb, and your houses shall be laid in ruins.
text_cn: 君王答复占星者说：“我是言出必行的，如果你们不告诉我那梦和梦的意义，你们必被万刮凌迟，你们的家必成为废墟。

text_en: But if you do tell me the dream and its interpretation, you shall receive from me gifts and rewards and great honor. Therefore tell me the dream and its interpretation. ”
text_cn: 但若你们告知我那梦和梦的意义，你们必获得我的礼物、赏报和崇高的尊荣；为此你们告诉我那梦和梦的意义吧！”

text_en: They answered a second time, “Let the king first tell his servants the dream, then we can give its interpretation. ”
text_cn: 他们又回答说：“请大王给你的仆人们说出梦来，好让我们给大王解释。”

text_en: The king answered, “I know with certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see I have firmly decreed:
text_cn: 君王回答说：“我明知你们是在想争取时间，因为你们明知我是言出必行的；

text_en: if you do not tell me the dream, there is but one verdict for you. You have agreed to speak lying and misleading words to me until things take a turn. Therefore, tell me the dream, and I shall know that you can give me its interpretation. ”
text_cn: 如果你们不告诉我那梦，为你们只有一个判决。那么。你们是想在我面前说谎欺骗，专待时机的转变。现在你们要告诉我那梦，好使我知道你们能为我解释那梦的意义。”

text_en: The Chaldeans answered the king, “There is no one on earth who can reveal what the king demands! In fact no king, however great and powerful, has ever asked such a thing of any magician or enchanter or Chaldean.
text_cn: 占星者在君王面前回答说：“世上没有一个人能说出大王所问的事，从来也没有一位君王，不论他如何伟大，有势力，向任何巫师、术士和占星者询问过这样的事。

text_en: The thing that the king is asking is too difficult, and no one can reveal it to the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with mortals. ”
text_cn: 大王询问的，确是件难事，没有谁能告诉大王，除非那不与血肉之躯同居的神祇（qí）。”

text_en: Because of this the king flew into a violent rage and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.
text_cn: 君王因此生气，大发雷霆，下令消灭巴比伦所有的智者。

text_en: The decree was issued, and the wise men were about to be executed; and they looked for Daniel and his companions, to execute them.
text_cn: 要杀智者的谕令发出之后，人们就搜索达尼尔和他的同伴，要将他们杀死。

text_en: Then Daniel responded with prudence and discretion to Arioch, the king’s chief executioner, who had gone out to execute the wise men of Babylon;
text_cn: 君王的卫队长阿黎约客出发，要杀巴比伦的智者之时，达尼尔机警明智地应付了他。

text_en: he asked Arioch, the royal official, “Why is the decree of the king so urgent? ” Arioch then explained the matter to Daniel.
text_cn: 达尼尔问君王的全权大臣阿黎约客说：“君王发出的谕令，为什么这样迫切？”阿黎约客遂将事情告诉了达尼尔。

text_en: So Daniel went in and requested that the king give him time and he would tell the king the interpretation.
text_cn: 达尼尔进去要求君王给他延长限期，好为君王详解梦兆。

text_en: Then Daniel went to his home and informed his companions, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
text_cn: 然后，回到家里，把事情告诉了自己的同伴阿纳尼雅、米沙耳和阿匝黎雅，

text_en: and told them to seek mercy from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and his companions with the rest of the wise men of Babylon might not perish.
text_cn: 要他们为这秘密事，恳求上天的大主施恩，挽救达尼尔和他的同伴与巴比伦其余的智者，免被杀害。

text_en: Then the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night, and Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
text_cn: 于是在夜间的神视中，这个秘密就启示给达尼尔了；达尼尔遂赞美上天的大主，

text_en: Daniel said: “Blessed be the name of God from age to age, for wisdom and power are his.
text_cn: 说：“愿天主的名，从永远直到永远受赞美，因为智慧和能力都属于他。

text_en: He changes times and seasons, deposes kings and sets up kings; he gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who have understanding.
text_cn: 是他变更四时季节，是他废黜君王，也兴立君王，赐智者以智慧，赐识者以聪敏；

text_en: He reveals deep and hidden things; he knows what is in the darkness, and light dwells with him.
text_cn: 是他启示隐秘深奥之事，洞悉暗中的事，因为光明居于他内。

text_en: To you, O God of my ancestors, I give thanks and praise, for you have given me wisdom and power, and have now revealed to me what we asked of you, for you have revealed to us what the king ordered. ”
text_cn: 我祖先的天主，我称谢赞颂你，因为你赐给了我智慧和能力。我们祈求你的事，现在你已晓谕了我们，使我们知道了君王的秘密。”

text_en: Therefore Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon, and said to him, “Do not destroy the wise men of Babylon; bring me in before the king, and I will give the king the interpretation. ”
text_cn: 达尼尔遂去见君王委派杀戮巴比伦智者的阿黎约客，对他这样说：“请暂且先不要杀害巴比伦的智者，带我去见君王，我要给君王解梦。”

text_en: Then Arioch quickly brought Daniel before the king and said to him: “I have found among the exiles from Judah a man who can tell the king the interpretation. ”
text_cn: 于是阿黎约客立刻引达尼尔去见君王，对君王说：“我从犹大被掳的子民中找得一人，他会给大王解梦。”

text_en: The king said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to tell me the dream that I have seen and its interpretation? ”
text_cn: 君王对名叫贝耳特沙匝的达尼尔说道：“你能告诉我，我所见的梦和梦的意义吗？”

text_en: Daniel answered the king, “No wise men, enchanters, magicians, or diviners can show to the king the mystery that the king is asking,
text_cn: 达尼尔回答君王说：“大王所问的奥秘，不是智者、术士、巫师和占卜者所能告诉大王的；

text_en: but there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries, and he has disclosed to King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen at the end of days. Your dream and the visions of your head as you lay in bed were these:
text_cn: 但是，在天上有一位启示奥秘的大主！他已将那日后要发生的事晓谕给大王。大王！你在床上脑中所得的梦，所见的神视是这样：

text_en: To you, O king, as you lay in bed, came thoughts of what would be hereafter, and the revealer of mysteries disclosed to you what is to be.
text_cn: 大王！你睡在床上忽然想到日后所要发生的事，启示奥秘的那位，把要发生的事已晓谕给你。

text_en: But as for me, this mystery has not been revealed to me because of any wisdom that I have more than any other living being, but in order that the interpretation may be known to the king and that you may understand the thoughts of your mind.
text_cn: 这奥秘已启示给我，并非因为我比任何活人更有智慧，而只是为把梦兆告诉大王，叫你知道你心中的思念。”

text_en: “You were looking, O king, and lo! there was a great statue. This statue was huge, its brilliance extraordinary; it was standing before you, and its appearance was frightening.
text_cn: “大王！你梦见一尊巨大的立像。这尊立像异常高大，非常光辉灿烂，立在君王面前，相貌可怕。

text_en: The head of that statue was of fine gold, its chest and arms of silver, its middle and thighs of bronze,
text_cn: 这尊立像，头是纯金的，胸和臂是银的，腹和股是铜的，

text_en: its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of clay.
text_cn: 胫（jìng）是铁的，脚一部份是铁，一部份是泥的。

text_en: As you looked on, a stone was cut out, not by human hands, and it struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay and broke them in pieces.
text_cn: 大王，你在观望，忽有一块石头，未经手凿即滚下，击中了立像，把铁泥的脚，打得粉碎；

text_en: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold, were all broken in pieces and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors; and the wind carried them away, so that not a trace of them could be found. But the stone that struck the statue became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.
text_cn: 同时铁、泥、铜、银和金立即完全粉碎，有如夏天禾场上的糠秕（bǐ），被风吹去，无踪无影；那块击碎立像的石头却变成了一座大山，占据了全地。”

text_en: “This was the dream; now we will tell the king its interpretation.
text_cn: “梦是这样的，现在我们要给大王解释梦兆。

text_en: You, O king, the king of kings—to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the might, and the glory,
text_cn: 大王！你是王中之王，上天大主赐给了你领土、势力、权威和尊荣，

text_en: into whose hand he has given human beings, wherever they live, the wild animals of the field, and the birds of the air, and whom he has established as ruler over them all—you are the head of gold.
text_cn: 凡有人居住的地方，田野的走兽，天空的飞鸟，都交在你手中，由你统治这一切，你便是那属金的头。

text_en: After you shall arise another kingdom inferior to yours, and yet a third kingdom of bronze, which shall rule over the whole earth.
text_cn: 在你以后，将兴起另一个比你稍弱的国家，以后兴起第三个国家，属铜，她要统辖大地；

text_en: And there shall be a fourth kingdom, strong as iron; just as iron crushes and smashes everything, it shall crush and shatter all these.
text_cn: 相继而来的是第四个，坚强如铁的国家，就如铁能粉碎击破一切，这个国家也要如铁粉碎击破一切。

text_en: As you saw the feet and toes partly of potter’s clay and partly of iron, it shall be a divided kingdom; but some of the strength of iron shall be in it, as you saw the iron mixed with the clay.
text_cn: 至于你见脚和趾，一部分是泥，一部分是铁，表示这个国家必要分裂，然而国内仍有铁的坚强，正如你见铁与泥相混一样。

text_en: As the toes of the feet were part iron and part clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong and partly brittle.
text_cn: 脚趾一部分是铁，一部份是泥，表示这个国家一部分强，一部分弱。

text_en: As you saw the iron mixed with clay, so will they mix with one another in marriage, but they will not hold together, just as iron does not mix with clay.
text_cn: 你见铁与泥混合，是说他们要与其他人种相混合，但是彼此不能相合，就如铁不能与泥相混合一样。

text_en: And in the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed, nor shall this kingdom be left to another people. It shall crush all these kingdoms and bring them to an end, and it shall stand forever;
text_cn: 在这些君王时代，上天的大主必要兴起一个永不灭亡的国家，她的王权也决不归于其他民族，她要粉碎和毁灭这一切邦国，惟独她永存弗替，

text_en: just as you saw that a stone was cut from the mountain not by hands, and that it crushed the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold. The great God has informed the king what shall be hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation trustworthy. ”
text_cn: 就如你所见那块未经手凿，即从山上滚下的石头，把铁、铜、泥、银和金打得粉碎一样。伟大的天主已晓谕了大王，今后将要发生的事。这梦是真实的，梦的解释也是正确的。”

text_en: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that a grain offering and incense be offered to him.
text_cn: 拿步高王于是俯首至地，叩拜达尼尔，下令给他奉上礼物和香品，

text_en: The king said to Daniel, “Truly, your God is God of gods and Lord of kings and a revealer of mysteries, for you have been able to reveal this mystery! ”
text_cn: 然后开口对达尼尔说：“的确，你们的天主是万神的天主，万王的主宰，奥秘的启示者，因为你能启示这个奥秘。”

text_en: Then the king promoted Daniel, gave him many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon and chief prefect over all the wise men of Babylon.
text_cn: 王遂擢（zhuó）升达尼尔，赏赐他很多珍贵的礼品，派他治理巴比伦全省，做巴比伦所有智者的首领。

text_en: Daniel made a request of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon. But Daniel remained at the king’s court.
text_cn: 达尼尔要求君王委任沙得辣客、默沙客和阿贝得乃哥掌管巴比伦省的政务；达尼尔自己却留在朝廷内。
